### PR Title Format

**IMPORTANT:** When this PR is squash-merged, the PR title becomes the commit message that triggers releases. Please use conventional commit format:

- `feat(scope): description` - New features (triggers minor version bump)
- `fix(scope): description` - Bug fixes (triggers patch version bump)
- `chore(scope): description` - Maintenance (no release)
- `refactor(scope): description` - Code refactoring (no release)
- `docs(scope): description` - Documentation changes (no release)

Example: `feat(components): add new navigation component`
